items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Yeah, he was on it, on, on trumpet and I played baritone.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was, he was co-writer, and who, who else, who else do you remember was on that session?
Uh, Emory, Emory Thompson. Uh huh. Uh, and. You, you know who I'm talking about? Yeah, I know who you're talking about. Yeah, he was on it, on, on trumpet and I played baritone.

Who's playing, who's playing piano? I don't know who, I don't even remember who else was on the, on the record. Jim Gardner was playing drums. He was? Yes. Well. There you go. I thought that might trip you had, cause I interviewed Jim and he talked, told me. No.
